_comment: Round 40. Machine-readable twin of docs/DEBT_STAGE_B_TRIAGE.md. Each entry is a Stage B finding that has been dispositioned (fixed with verified source, fixed with source named but not yet quoted, flagged as a case-law gloss awaiting counsel, covered elsewhere, or HORIZON). The corroboration runner passes a node's entries into the Stage B prompt and asks the model to tag any overlapping edge case with the matching id; only UNTAGGED material findings count toward the gate (ratified 2026-09-04). Adding an entry here is a disposition decision, not a content edit: it requires the finding to have been actually addressed in the rules file or explicitly accepted for counsel review. The docs file remains the human-readable queue of record; keep the two in sync. Round 43 adds a '_global' list: cross-cutting dispositions the runner (from round 44) appends to EVERY node's prompt, so a theme that has been dispositioned corpus-wide (bankruptcy, validation-dispute cease, 1692c bars, state overlays) is tagged rather than re-reported on each node. A global entry is not a licence to ignore a node that says something WRONG about the theme -- the prompt says so.

_global.theme: Pending bankruptcy (automatic stay, 11 U.S.C. 362(a)(6)) or discharge (524(a)(2)) overrides any node's collection/enforcement/limitations analysis
_global.summary: Cross-cutting. Encoded as a threshold screen on the nodes where it has surfaced (CA-SOL-WRITTEN round 29; call-frequency round 43). Corpus-wide design: a shared BANKRUPTCY-OVERLAY gate node is on the HORIZON list; until it exists, every node is deemed to carry this disposition -- report the finding only if the node's OWN text says something WRONG about bankruptcy, not merely because it does not mention it.

_global.theme: A timely written validation dispute under 15 U.S.C. 1692g(b) suspends all collection until verification -- overrides any conduct node's frequency/timing analysis
_global.summary: Cross-cutting across the FDCPA conduct nodes. Encoded in FDCPA-VALIDATION-NOTICE-1692g (verified) and as a threshold screen on the call-frequency node (round 43). Report only if a node's own text contradicts it.

_global.theme: 1692c(a) (represented by counsel; inconvenient time/place; employer prohibits) and 1692c(c) (written cease/refusal) independently bar contact regardless of any other node's analysis
_global.summary: Cross-cutting across the FDCPA conduct nodes; encoded on the call-frequency node (rounds 34, 38) and the 1692e/1692f catalog nodes. Report only if a node's own text contradicts it.
